output_adapter.name: aperture
output_adapter.evidence: geometry and saved NBT only; runtime assertions remain pending

reset.method: restore pristine source checkpoint including block entities, inventories, entities, queues and RNG seed 0

unit_tests.name: idle
assertions: mapped aperture remains open
report unsolicited motion, item/entity loss and pending activity

unit_tests.name: two_cycles
assertions: exact aperture materials at each phase
repeat first cycle output on second cycle
no moving-piston residue at settled endpoints
compare native/cached/shadow tick-end traces with fresh vanilla

benchmark.workload: same reset and exact interactions as unit test; report elapsed and thread CPU time
